name: optimize_python_count_in_loop
description: Optimizes a frequency count that calls list.count() per element (O(n^2)) to a single pass
prompts: frequencies(items) in frequency.py returns a dict mapping each distinct value to the number of times it appears in items. It's implemented as {x: items.count(x) for x in items}, which calls items.count(x) - a full linear scan - once for every element, making it O(n^2) and far too slow for tens of thousands of items. Rewrite frequencies to compute the same dict in a single pass (e.g. collections.Counter or a manual dict tally), returning exactly the same mapping of value -> count. Keep the function name and signature.
